title: PRESOLICITATION NOTICE FOR GATE HOIST MACHINERY PAINTING AND HOIST HOUSE REHABILITATION FOR FOX RIVER DAMS, WISCONSIN
description: ** This Pre-Solicitation Notice is being issued by the United States Army Corps of Engineers- Chicago District to inform interested vendors of the district?s intent to issue a solicitation for Gate Hoist Machinery Painting and Hoist House Rehabilitation for Fox River Dams, Wisconsin. ** ** PROJECT INFORMATION: The Government is seeking a contractor to 1) repaint the gate hoisting machinery and 2) to rehabilitate the gate hoist houses for 9 (nine) US Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) operated dams on the Fox River, Wisconsin. Base 2 hoist houses rehabilitation work at each dam includes: (1) replacing the existing shingle roofing with metallic sheet roofing; (2) replacing current doors with heavy duty commercial doors (modify existing door wall framing as needed ISO heavier doors); (3) replacing exterior vinyl siding with galvalume siding; (4) replacing the exterior soffit fascia; and (5) insulating the ceiling and wall cavities.Material specifications and installation procedures will be in accordance with the USACE EM 385-1-1 requirements and procedures summarized in a scope of work. ** ** ACQUISITION INFORMATION: Competition for this acquisition is RESERVED EXCLUSIVELY for Small Business Concerns. The North American Industry System Classification Code is 236220, with a small business size standard in dollars of $45.0 Million. All responsible sources may submit a quotation, bid, or proposal, as appropriate, which will be considered by the agency. The requirement is for one (1) year. The solicitation package, bid opening, and award is planned for advertisement Fourth Quarter Fiscal Year 2026. ** ** Prospective vendors can download the solicitation and related documents only from DoWs Procurement Integrated Enterprise Environment (PIEE) system, once it is released. The PDF files can be viewed, navigated, or printed using Adobe Acrobat Reader. ** ** IMPORTANT POLICY: Contractors are REQUIRED to be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM) AT THE TIME ITS BID/PROPOSAL IS SUBMITTED, in orderto comply with the annual representations and certifications requirements. Registration can be completed free of charge at www.sam.gov. Contractors also must register with sam.gov, prior to registering PIEE. Your firm must register with PIEE in order to access the solicitation and to place a bid/proposal in response to the upcoming USACE Solicitation. Use the PIEE System Registration link: ? https://piee.eb.mil and follow the instructions on their website. Request for Solicitation packages made by telephone, fax, or e-mail will not be honored. ** ** Information regarding the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers process for settling requests for equitable adjustments and duration goals to achieve definitization of equitable adjustments for change orders under construction contracts can be found by going to https://www.usace.army.mil/Strategic-Partnerships/Partnering/mod/129895/details/443/ then scrolling down on right hand side of page by clicking on ?View FFP Contract Changes Playbook Here?. ** ** The Point of Contract for this acquisition is Ericka Hillard at ericka.d.hillard@usace.army.mil. ** ** Please include Solicitation number W912P626BA026 on all correspondence. **

Justification for an Exception to Fair Opportunity Innovation Associates, Inc.
description: This JEFO is valid from the date of approval, July 21, 2025, through the conclusion of the period of performance, July 22, 2029. This is a Class JEFO for the purchase of annual pharmacy automation equipment maintenance service and support program under Innovation Associates, Inc.�s DLA Troop Support Patient Monitoring and Capital Equipment (PMCE) Contract SPE2D1-19-D-0017. Annual maintenance coverage consists of equipment repair and software updates. Contract SPE2D1-19-D-0017 was awarded under the PMCE Program solicitation SPE2D1-17-R-0001. This Class JEFO will apply to all Service Maintenance Agreement (SMA) orders placed under the subject contract commencing with the date of approval of the Class JEFO through July 22, 2029, when the five-year base and five-year option periods expire. Innovation Associates is the only vendor who can perform maintenance on its Innovation Pharmacy Workflow and Automation System, iA NEXiA, software and ensure the installed systems� performance and cybersecurity accreditation is maintained. Innovation is the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) and only source for the maintenance services required on the iA NEXiA units because they are the OEM with the sole proprietary license for the operating software. The iA NEXiA, formally known as PharmAssist, is an automated medication dispensing system for oral and solid medications with linked and computerized quality assurance software. The iA NEXiA system is integrated with the Composite Health Care System (CHCS) using digital imagery and bar code technology incorporated into the entirely paperless prescription filling process. The linked quality assurance software with digital images of prescriptions provides a significant safety measure by verifying accuracy for all prescriptions filled at various CHCS-hosted pharmacy sites against the original scanned hard copy prescription. The annual maintenance coverage provided by Innovation consists of equipment repair and software updates. Repairs include annual preventative maintenance (PM) and minor equipment adjustments due to wear and tear. Software updates can include but are not limited to updated drug lists and cyber security changes. The required software updates are proprietary to Innovation. Repairs of the iA NEXiA equipment often require interaction with the iA NEXiA proprietary operating software. Innovation Associates, is the sole manufacturer of the iA NEXiA and are capable of maintaining all system information security certifications, testing and on-going Information Assurance (IA), including security updates and patches. Accordingly, only Innovation Associates can maintain the Authority to Operate and the critical security status of the iA NEXiA systems on an ongoing basis under yearly maintenance programs. Security updates and patches must be thoroughly tested by the manufacturer prior to being applied to their system; therefore, only Innovation Associates can provide maintenance for their manufactured equipment.

title: Germany – IT services: consulting, software development, Internet and support – Dynamisches Beschaffungssystem zur Beschaffung von verschiedenen IT-Dienstleistungen
description: Ziel des uni-assist e.V. ist, ein neues Service-IT-System zur Unterstützung der Zulassungsvorbereitung an deutschen Hochschulen zu entwickeln. Ausgehend von einer am Ende ihres Lebenszyklus angelangten proprietären Software (aBIS) und angesichts der sich beschleunigenden Digitalisierung der Zulassungsvorbereitung, dem weiter wachsenden Interesse internationaler degree seeker an einem Studium in Deutschland sowie dem zurzeit häufig beschriebenen Bedarf an (internationalen) Fachkräften in Deutschland 1 ist es für den Verein unabdingbar, zügig ein neues System zu etablieren, um (i) internationalen Studieninteressierten eine intuitiv und einfach nutzbare Plattform zur Einreichung ihrer Studienbewerbungen zur Verfügung zu stellen, (ii) den im Verein organisierten deutschen Hochschulen ein transparentes und faires Auswahlverfahren zu ermöglichen, (iii) die internen Bewertungsprozesse effizient und qualitativ hochwertig abzubilden und (iv) auf Basis der generierten Daten, Handlungsempfehlungen und Verfahrensoptimierungen für interne und externe Stakeholder*innen zu entwickeln. Zentrale Ziele der Neuentwicklung sind (i) die technologische sukzessive Ablösung des Alt-Systems, (ii) die Erhöhung des Automatisierungsgrads in den Verfahrensprozessen und (iii) die möglichst vollständige Digitalisierung der Prozesse bei (iv) gleichzeitiger Steigerung der Usability für die Nutzer*innen sowie (v) der Wahrung und Sicherstellung aller (datenschutz-) rechtlichen Normen. Dafür benötigt der AG die nachfolgenden IT-Dienstleistungen (Kategorie): 1. Unterstützung in der Softwareentwicklung (bspw. Programmieren, Steuern der Scrum-Teams, Testen) 2. Unterstützung des Anforderungsmanagements 3. Unterstützung in der Systemadministration 4. Unterstützung in Wahrung und Weiterentwicklung der IT- und Datenschutzsicherheit 5. Unterstützung in der Koordination des Softwareentwicklungsprojekts und Beratung der IT-Abteilung (bspw. PMO, Projektleitung, Agile Coaching, Datenmanagement)

title: Vehicle Wrap Advertising - Delaware
description: Notice Type: Sources Sought Notice ID: W50S6X26Q0008 Title: Vehicle Wrap Advertising - Delaware NAICS Code: 541810 (Advertising Agencies) OR 541850 (Outdoor Advertising) 1. DISCLAIMER This is a Sources Sought Notice only. This notice is issued solely for market research and planning purposes in accordance with FAR Part 10. It does NOT constitute a Request for Quote (RFQ), Request for Proposal (RFP), or a promise to issue a solicitation in the future. This notice does not commit the U.S. Government to contract for any supply or service whatsoever. The Government will not pay for any information or administrative costs incurred in response to this notice; all costs associated with responding to this notice will be solely at the interested party�s expense. Not responding to this notice does not preclude participation in any future competitive solicitation, if one is issued. 2. BACKGROUND & REQUIREMENT SUMMARY The 166th Mission Support Contracting is conducting market research to identify potential small business and socioeconomic contractors capable of providing a targeted vehicle-wrap advertising and brand ambassador campaign. The contractor shall provide fully wrapped vehicles that will operate in highly visible, targeted zones across Delaware (Middletown, Dover, Georgetown/Milton, and Delaware Beach Towns). The core deliverables include: Fleet Branding: Ten (10) fully wrapped vehicles � complete coverage (doors, hood, trunk, and back windows), to include installation and de-installation. Targeting & Vetting: Sourcing drivers whose daily routes align with the specified target zones. Drivers must pass comprehensive background checks. Collateral Distribution: Distribution of up to 2,000 Government-provided brochures (approx. 200 per vehicle) by the drivers. Analytics & Reporting: Monthly reporting to include Proof of Performance photos, GPS tracking heat maps, mileage tracking, and verified impression counts to calculate overall campaign exposure. 3. REQUESTED INFORMATION / CAPABILITY STATEMENT Interested parties are requested to submit a Capability Statement (no more than 5 pages) addressing their ability to perform the services described above. Please include the following administrative information and answer the generic and specific capability questions below. A. Administrative & Company Information: Company Name, Address, and Point of Contact (Name, Title, Phone, Email). Unique Entity ID (UEI) and CAGE Code. Business Size and Socioeconomic Status under NAICS 541810 (e.g., Small Business, 8(a), HUBZone, SDVOSB, WOSB). Are these services available on an existing Government-wide Acquisition Contract (GWAC) or GSA Multiple Award Schedule (MAS)? If yes, please provide the contract number. Are your services considered commercial under the definition provided in FAR 2.101? B. Capability Questions: Do you have an established network of local drivers operating within Middletown, Dover, Georgetown/Milton, and the Delaware Beach Towns? How do you map and vet driver routes to ensure the wrapped vehicles are frequently operating in our specific target geographic areas? Are your drivers willing and contractually able to distribute physical promotional collateral (brochures) to passengers/the public, and how do you track their distribution compliance? What specific background checks (e.g., criminal, driving record) do you mandate for your drivers before campaign launch? Do you have the capability to provide monthly GPS heat maps and real-time mileage tracking of the wrapped vehicles? How do you calculate your impression metrics, and do you use an independent or third-party verification system for this data? 4. Pre-Solicitation Questions & Answers (Q&A) The following Anticipated Q&A is provided to assist interested parties in understanding the Government's requirement and the current market research phase. Q1: Is there an incumbent contractor currently performing these exact services? A1: No, this is a new requirement for the Government. Q2: Has a decision been made regarding a small business set-aside for this requirement? A2: No. The purpose of this Sources Sought is to conduct market research to determine the availability of capable small businesses (including 8(a), HUBZone, SDVOSB, and WOSB). The Government will use the responses to this notice to make an informed decision on the acquisition strategy and any potential set-asides. Q3: Will the Government provide the 2,000 brochures/literature pieces, or is the contractor responsible for the printing costs? A3: The Government will provide the physical brochures/literature pieces to the contractor. The contractor is only responsible for the allocation and distribution of these materials via the campaign drivers. Q4: Does the Government require the vehicles to be dedicated solely to this campaign, or can they be active rideshare vehicles operating their normal routes? Ziel des gemeinsamen Messprogramms ist die Ermittlung der Exposition von Beschäftigten gegenüber Asbest. Untersucht werden Tätigkeiten auf Baustellen beim sogenannten Bauen im Bestand, d.h. Tätigkeiten in Gebäuden die zwischen ca. 1960 und 1995 errichtet oder grundlegend modernisiert wurden. Die vorliegende Beschaffung betrifft einen Open-House-Vertrag deren Gegenstand die Beauftragung von Fachsanierern ist. Es handelt sich um ein sog. Open-House-Verfahren, d.h. nicht um ein klassisches Vergabeverfahren nach den vergaberechtlichen Regelungen, insbesondere der 4. Teil des GWB sowie die VgV sowie die VOB/A , bei dem der Auftraggeber die Auswahl des Auftragnehmers zu verantworten hat.
